goal: Verify build-mode handoff semantics in the Bakeoff CLI and run skill: selected patch paths must appear only when a canonical winner exists; unresolved or judge-failed build runs must not imply a patch is safe; build output must never recommend judge-only rerun.
background: Acceptance: (1) Every code path that emits a selected/winning patch path is guarded by a non-null canonical_winner; no summary, report, or recommendation surfaces providers/<id>/build/diff.patch when canonical_winner is empty. (2) Build runs with exit 3 (unresolved disagreement) or exit 4 (decision-incomplete / judge failure) never include a 'selected patch', 'winning patch', or applied-patch line; the absence of a canonical winner is stated explicitly. (3) No build code path or skill text recommends 'bakeoff rerun --judge-only' for build runs; the judge-only rerun is research-only. Concrete files to inspect: internal/commands/buildcmd/{decision.go,summary.go,report.go,run.go,run_test.go}; internal/decision/decision.go; internal/summary/summary.go; internal/report/report.go; internal/commands/reruncmd/rerun.go; skills/bakeoff-run/SKILL.md; skills/bakeoff/SKILL.md. Also check internal/manifest/manifest.go for selected-patch path derivation. Report exact file:line citations for each violation or confirmation.

facet.focus: Audit build-mode handoff semantics for three invariants: (1) selected patch paths (providers/WINNER/build/diff.patch) appear only when decision.canonical_winner is non-empty; (2) build runs with exit 3 or exit 4 never imply a selected patch exists; (3) judge-only rerun (bakeoff rerun --judge-only) is never recommended for build runs - it is research-only. Cite exact file:line for each finding. Treat skill text and Go code symmetrically.
include: Build command summary, report, and decision code
Build run tests and table-driven exit-code cases
Decision and report packages used by build summaries
Run skill text covering build-mode output and recommendations
Rerun command logic and gating on run type
exclude: Research-only paths that legitimately recommend judge-only rerun
Unrelated CLI commands (ls, history, escalate non-build)
